author: skellyboi730
body:
• Morbified
  • Excessive Infractions
  • I would like to rejoin the community because Avicus has been the server of memories for me, I started playing as soon as I got minecraft and being a member of the Avicus community means alot to me because it is unique, there will not be other servers like this also I personally think I have served enough time and have certainly changed. I was very immature in the short duration of time I was still unexcluded, however now this is no longer the case. If one member of staff is inclined to retract my previous infractions that would be nice, but if not then thats cool too I (If it is ok with you) can try another time.
  • Please consider this correspondance, but as I said if 'no' is the final conclusion then thats cool too! Kindest Regards.
